title: Cluster 03 Drill — Gene and Chromosomal Mutations, Molecular Techniques and Bioethics
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 2 · 9 questions · 148 marks · cumulative over Cluster 1 + Cluster 2 + Cluster 3 + Book 1
intro_html:
Answers sit directly under each part, hidden. Click Show answer only after you have said your full reasoning aloud for that part. Check (a) before you start (b) - that is the point of the layout.

Every stem is one or two sentences and every answer is long. No stem lists the axes to compare on, no stem tells you which option is wrong, and no stem contains its own answer. There is no multiple choice this time; every part is open. Nine of the eighteen parts carry the real figure from the paper it came from, not a redrawing.

Cumulative. Seven parts need an earlier cluster said cold - Q1(a) the reading frame, degeneracy and the stop codon from Cluster 2; Q3(a) the whole replication enzyme roster from Cluster 1, because PCR is defined here by what it does not use; Q4(a) the sugar-phosphate backbone and why the phosphates are negative; Q5(b) hydrogen bonding and melting temperature; Q6(b) enhancers and silencers acting at a distance; Q7(a) the centromere and the kinetochore; Q9 the transcriptional level of control. Four parts need Book 1 cold - Q1(a) primary structure deciding tertiary conformation, Q2(a) haemoglobin as the worked quaternary-structure example, Q3(b) what makes an enzyme thermostable and what an optimum temperature is, and Q4(b) the difference between a charged R group and a non-polar one. A Cluster 1 or Book 1 gap surfacing here is worth more than a clean Cluster 3 answer, so say it out loud when it happens.

What the marks reward, and it is not what Cluster 2 rewarded. Every mutation chain starts at the gene - a scheme in this Book rejects the first two marking points outright if the answer never mentions the DNA. Every technique step carries its purpose, because procedure alone scores nothing. And the lexicon is strict: aneuploidy not "Down syndrome" when naming the consequence of non-disjunction, non-homologous in the translocation definition, Taq polymerase not "a heat-stable polymerase", anode, constant charge density, and glutamate to valine with hydrophilic and hydrophobic attached to each.

2(l) how gene mutations result in disease, including sickle cell anaemiaQ2, Q4
2(m) bioethics of genetic maternal screening, including trisomy-21Q8
reach-back 2(a) and 2(b) DNA structure, replication and its enzymes (Cluster 1)Q3, Q4, Q5
reach-back 2(h) non-coding DNA, the centromere and the kinetochore (Cluster 1)Q7
reach-back 2(c) and 2(i) transcription, translation and the five levels of control (Cluster 2)Q1, Q6, Q9
reach-back Core Idea 1 protein structure, bonding and enzymes (Book 1)Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4

Three traps here carry measured failure rates from real examiner reports: the meiosis I against meiosis II deduction in Q7(a), where the nearest published equivalent was answered correctly by only 45.66% of the cohort; the DNA-against-RNA primer point inside Q3(a), at 54.60%; and the expression-profile reading in Q9(a), which the examiner recorded as poorly done because candidates read the bands and then stopped without naming a regulatory cause.

A third of the raw question bank for this cluster is cut content, and none of it appears here. Restriction enzyme recognition sequences, sticky against blunt ends, restriction mapping and RFLP, cloning vectors and plasmids, ligation, insertional inactivation, transformation, gene therapy, DNA sequencing and profiling, Northern blotting and FISH mechanism are all absent from the 9477 syllabus. The one thing that survives is restriction digestion as step one of a Southern blot, because LO 2(j)(iii) asks for the procedure - so Q5(a) names the step and tests nothing about the enzyme.

One warning about Q8. Fifteen years of prelims contain nothing on maternal screening for trisomy 21, and all four 9477 specimen papers contain zero bioethics questions, so Q8 has no past paper behind it and is built from the school's own chapters 2.5 and 2.7. LO 2(m) says discuss and is worth several marks, so build the answer anyway - it is the only question here you cannot check against a real examiner.
